rule: A legacy label maps to the highest R level whose proof obligation it is guaranteed to meet (floor). Anything stronger needs the named condition to be evidenced separately.

levels.name: Specification
levels.proof_obligation: Written, reviewable specification with explicit claims and boundaries

levels.name: Cryptographically receipted execution
levels.proof_obligation: Reproducible local execution bound to canonical hashes and a valid origin receipt

levels.name: Independent reproduction
levels.proof_obligation: Two valid receipts from distinct screened witnesses on non-origin hardware

levels.name: Independent reimplementation
levels.proof_obligation: Implementation produced from the specification by an independent party and shown equivalent under the defined challenge suite

levels.name: Production-authorized
levels.proof_obligation: Sustained operational evidence, applicable safety/regulatory gates, accountable human authority, rollback and incident controls

orthogonal_axes.name: Witness
orthogonal_axes.open_question: No repository defines W1 or above. Rungs must be specified before any artifact may claim them.

orthogonal_axes.name: Operational authority
orthogonal_axes.open_question: No repository defines O1 or above. Rungs must be specified before any artifact may claim them.

mappings.label: E4
mappings.condition_for_higher: R4 only with two receipts from distinct screened witnesses; Lumen E4 requires one independent machine

mappings.label: E5
mappings.condition_for_higher: R5 needs independent reimplementation; R6 needs explicit production authorization, which E5 does not include

source_ladders.ordering: Mappings are listed in order of proof strength

mappings.label: E2.5
mappings.condition_for_higher: R3 needs a valid origin receipt bound to canonical hashes

mappings.label: E3.1
mappings.condition_for_higher: Package structure alone is not a receipted execution
mappings.note: Numbered above E3 but proves less (structure, not a receipted run); listed by proof strength, not label order

mappings.label: E3.5
mappings.condition_for_higher: Adds runtime-state qualification inside R3; still origin-controlled

mappings.label: E4
mappings.condition_for_higher: R4 only with two receipts from distinct screened witnesses on non-origin hardware

source_ladders.ordering: Mappings are listed in order of proof strength; label numbering is not authoritative

mappings.label: REPORTED
mappings.meaning: Claimed, not verified from repository state
mappings.condition_for_higher: A claim is not a specification unless its boundaries are written down

mappings.label: VERIFIED-LOCAL
mappings.meaning: Observed locally without committed tests or receipts

mappings.label: VERIFIED-REPO
mappings.meaning: Committed code, deterministic instructions, reproducible tests

mappings.label: FAILED
mappings.meaning: Tested and did not satisfy the claim

source_ladders.ordering: Mappings are listed in order of proof strength
